The file /app/input.txt contains one integer per line.

Create the file /app/output.txt with exactly this content:

- Line 1: the sum of all the integers in /app/input.txt
- Line 2: the number of integers in /app/input.txt
- The following lines: the same integers sorted in ascending numeric order, one per line

The file must end with a trailing newline.
Let me start by reading the input file to understand the data.<tool_call><function=Shell><parameter=command>cat /app/input.txt</parameter></function></tool_call>
